t: Morning, little brother. Oh wait, you're the YOUNGER one.
Alright, big man. And I do mean BIG.
Ah, the youngest has arrived. Did you have a nice extra day in the womb?
Hello, Ronnie. I came as soon as I felt the earthquake.
I've been doing intermittent fasting, Ron. You've been doing intermittent feasting.
Our mum says we're twins. Our mum is being VERY generous to you.
I went to the gym today. You went to the gym once. To use the vending machine.
Ron, I'm not saying you're big, but when you walk past the telly, I miss two adverts.
You're the only person I know who's been banned from a buffet for 'stamina'.
If eating was an Olympic sport, you'd be the whole Team GB.
Chelsea, Ronnie? Of course you support a team that plays in BLUE. Like the cheese.
I love you, brother. From a safe distance. Because of the gravity.
Ronnie, the Oysterfleet has a pie named after you. It's just called 'Gone'.
I saw a nature documentary yesterday. You were in it. As the migration.
Respect your elders, Ronnie. I've been alive a WHOLE day longer than you.
When I was your age — so, yesterday — I had a six-pack. Oh wait, I still do.
I've got 24 hours more wisdom than you, and all 24 of them are telling me to hide the biscuits.
You're the youngest, Ron. You'll understand when you're older. Like tomorrow.
Mate... you're getting PRETTY large.
Is that a new chin, or are you just pleased to see me?
Ronnie, you're blocking my sun. I need it for my abs.
I tried to take a picture of you, but my phone asked if I wanted panorama mode.
Your shadow just asked for its own room.
I say all this because I care, Ronnie. Mainly about the furniture.
You know I love you, mate. There's just a lot more of you to love now.
Your shirt says 10, but your size says the whole team.
Why have you got 400 empty cans and one sock?
Your bed's got a Ronnie-shaped crater. NASA want to study it.
Ronnie? Hello? Is anyone home? Is everyone in the fridge?
Standing still, Ron? Your stomach must be thinking.
I'll wait. I've got abs to look after anyway.
You've been staring at that doughnut for ages. Make a decision. NO, not that one.
Ron? Are you buffering? Or digesting?
You've gone quiet. Is it a food coma? Blink twice.
I'll just do some sit-ups while you decide which snack to eat.
You eat like the food owes you money, Ronnie.
Chew, Ronnie. It's a verb. Look it up.
I blinked and it was gone. Like a magic trick. A sad one.
Ron, there's a crumb on your... everything.
The way you just ate that, I think it should be on a nature programme.
Did you even chew that? Did you even SEE that?
Slow down, mate, you're making the food nervous.
That noise. That noise you just made. I'll hear that in my dreams.
Ron, the fridge just filed a restraining order.
That burger didn't stand a chance. It had a family.
Was that a bite or did a bin lorry just reverse?
That's his favourite. You can tell because he's crying.
Another MONSTOR? Your blood type is now "Mango".
You drink so many of those, your burps are sponsored.
LOCO MODE? Ron, you were already loco.
Ow! I'm just trying to help!
Ron! I'm just trying to HELP you!
That's assault on an older man, Ronnie. I'm a whole day older!
Ow, my abs! You could have hit anything but the abs!
Did you just throw food at me? You never throw food. Something's wrong.
You've knocked my hair out of place. This is a crime.
I'm not angry. I'm just disappointed. And slightly sticky.
Okay, that one was fair. But you're still huge.
Was that a slap or did a sofa fall on me?
I'm on YOUR side, mate! I'm the only one who's honest with you!
I came here out of LOVE, Ronnie!
Fine, fine! I'll stop helping! ... You're still massive, by the way.
Return to sender? RUDE. That broccoli loved you.
Ow! Hit by my own broccoli! The irony is delicious. Unlike the broccoli, apparently.
I'm just trying to get ONE vegetable inside you!
Have some broccoli, Ron! I'm just trying to help!
Incoming vitamins! Open wide!
Here comes the aeroplane! It's a broccoli aeroplane!
One floret, Ron. For me. For your elder.
Catch! It's green, it's good for you, you've never seen one!
You SWATTED it? That was organic!
He moves fast for a big lad when there's a vegetable involved.
Fastest you've moved all year, that.
Fine. The broccoli and I will remember this.
We had him. We HAD him!
A vegetable! Inside Ronnie! Somebody call the news!
Look at his face. Like a cat that's been told about Mondays.
That's one of your five a day. You've only got four hundred to go.
Did your shirt just make a noise? I think it's crying.
Ronnie... I'm not saying you're big, but your chins have started a group chat.
That's FIVE now, Ron. I'm calling your mum.
Where's your neck gone? Has anyone seen Ronnie's neck? Reward offered.
Ron, you've got your own postcode now. And weather.
MASSIVE. The floor's filing a complaint, Ronnie.
I can see you from SPACE, Ron. NASA rang. They're worried.
RONNIE XXXL. There's nothing left to eat. There's nothing left of ME. I'm proud of you. Disgusted. But proud.
I'm one day older than you, Ronnie. Which makes me in charge of this intervention.
I'm just trying to help, Ron. By timing you. And judging.
Get the broccoli, Ronnie! The broccoli! ...he got the cake.
Ian, is that broccoli on the grill? Lovely. Ronnie won't eat it, but lovely.
Chloe's lovely, Ron. Don't mess this up. Like you messed up my ball.
Who took my ball? RONNIE. Did you EAT my ball?
I'll help behind the bar! I'm just trying to help! Why is everyone shouting?
Have a lie down, Ron! It's for your health!
TIMBERRRR!
Whoops! My foot was just... there.
Floor time! The floor's got no calories, Ronnie!
THE FINAL BALL, RONNIE!
Catch, Ron! ...you didn't catch it.
BALLED. Absolutely balled.
Ronnie. Ronnie. Ronnie. Ronnie. Ronnie. RONNIE.
Ron, quick question. Come here. No, closer.
Ronnie, your shoelace is undone. Look down. LOOK DOWN.
Hey Ron, what's that behind you? Don't turn round. Do turn round.
Ronnie, put me down. Ronnie. RONNIE. I am a grown man and I am older than you!
WORTH IIIIIIT!
RONNIE! THAT WAS FROM THE TOILET! Game over. GAME OVER.
vegSwat
You're behind the bar tonight, Ron. Serve the punters. Do NOT drink the stock.
The whole squad's out tonight, Ron. Everyone's watching what you eat. I'm just trying to help.
Supermarket Sweep! Ninety seconds, Ron. Oliver's on security. He takes it VERY seriously.
Ian's barbecue, Ron. He says it's healthy. It's not healthy. Be quick.
Date night! I'm over here on my own table. Behave, Ron. She's watching. Mostly.
Right, Ron. The whole squad's here. It's an intervention. I'm just trying to help.
VEGGIE WAR. Everyone, positions. Aim for the mouth.
Harry's going to throw the food AWAY from you. In theory.
Sixty seconds, Ron. Show me what you've got. Actually, don't.
Player two! Beat that. Please don't.
Eat-Off! Player one, sixty seconds. Go.
Back to normal then. Normal for you.
Free roam, Ron. Have a wander. Nobody's attacking you. Today.
Another intervention, another failure. I'll tell your mum you were good. I'll lie.
Well done, Ron. You ate the level. The WHOLE level.
Time! Put the trolley down, Ron. PUT IT DOWN.
Ian says you're not invited next year. He says that every year.
Harry's retiring. From throwing. And dating, hopefully.
Romance isn't dead, Ron. You ate it.
Last orders! ...Ron, last orders means for THEM, not you.
Time! ...the scales have left the building.
Time! ...both of you are a disgrace. I'm very proud.
Me and you, Ron. Chelsea till we die. Blue is the colour. Shame it's also the colour of that cheese you ate.
You call that a pint, Ron? My broccoli's got a better head on it.
Evening, barman. Well. Bar... something.
Pint of Guinness please, Ron. I've booked the week off to wait for it.
Look at you behind a bar, Ronnie. Like a fox running a henhouse. A slow fox.
Alright, Ron! I'll have whatever's quickest. So nothing, then.
Ron, you've poured that Guinness like you're putting out a fire. Let it SETTLE.
Two-part pour, Ronnie. Two parts. Not one big panic.
Is that a pint or a cappuccino? It's all head, Ron. ALL HEAD.
That's the wrong change, Ron. I gave you a tenner. You gave me a beer mat and a wink.
This table's so sticky my elbow's been here since Tuesday.
There's a queue out the door, Ron. Not for here. For the Wetherspoons over the road.
Empty glasses everywhere, Ronnie. It looks like the bottle bank's had a breakdown.
You've been on the till ten minutes and it's already asked for the manager.
Last orders, Ron? You haven't done FIRST orders yet.
You pull a pint like you're starting a lawnmower.
You pull a pint like it owes you money, Ron.
I asked for a Guinness, Ron. That's a Coke with a hat on.
Ronnie, the glass goes UNDER the tap. Under. The bit with the hole.
I've had faster service at the dentist. And they were nicer to me.
Here's a tip for the barman: learn the prices. That's the tip.
The drip tray's fuller than the pints, Ron.
You've wiped that table three times and it's still got a pint ring. And a chip. And a postcode.
Card machine says declined, Ron. Not my card. The machine. It's declined to work with you.
The ice well's empty, Ron! You're running the only warm pub in England.
Is this table service or table abandonment, Ron?
Ronnie, you've topped up a Guinness with lager. That's a crime in Dublin. And here.
I'm one day older than you, and I've still been waiting longer for this pint.
Running the pub, Ronnie? You couldn't run a bath.
Who trained you, Ron? Was it a cat?
That's not a head on that pint, that's a duvet.
You've served the kid a cider, the nan an energy drink and me nothing. Bold strategy.
I'm just trying to help, Ron. Help yourself to a job somewhere else.
Five-star pub. One-star barman.
Ron, those glasses on table six have been there so long they're paying rent.
The till's further out than your last orders, Ronnie.
Ron? Hello? Is the bar open, or are you buffering?
I've been stood here so long my pint's gone out of date.
Any time tonight, barman. Any time this YEAR.
Ron, the punters are waving. That's not hello, that's a distress signal.
Standing still, Ron? The glasses won't collect themselves. Believe me, I've asked them.
Eating the bar snacks, Ron? They're for the CUSTOMERS.
That was table four's scampi fries, Ronnie.
You're meant to SELL the crisps, Ron. Not test every bag.
Stock take's going to be a short one tonight.
Drinking on shift, Ron? That's coming out of your tips.
You're meant to pour them, Ron, not finish them.
The landlord's going to count the barrels, Ronnie. Then the takings. Then you.
Ow! You can't hit the customers, Ron! I'm a REGULAR!
That's no way to treat a man waiting for a pint!
Is that how you tell someone it's last orders?
I'll be leaving a review, Ronnie. One star. The star's for the crisps.
Barred? You can't bar ME. I'm the only one who tips!
Customer service, Ron! Look it up!
I came here for a quiet pint, Ronnie. A QUIET PINT.
Ron, you've drunk more of the stock than you've sold. The landlord's doing sums.
Another one for the barman? He's had more than the punters, Ron.
You're not behind the bar any more, Ronnie. You're propping it up.
